verdict.rationale: Any public web service with documentation could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this story applies to IP India. A direct probe found https://ipindia.gov.in/llms.txt returns HTTP 404, and none of the other evidence describes agent-oriented documentation; the e-filing, search and fee pages are ordinary human-facing portal pages.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
